_comment: Region MLE tool. AutoForm over RegionMleViewModel: an Analysis dock (CLSM + IRF file lists, detector/window, region source and Fit23 settings, Run button) plus result docks (the region image with markers, and a per-region fit table). Fits the regions the Spot Finder found by single-lifetime Poisson MLE (Fit23); it does not segment.

sections.title: CLSM imaging files
sections.description: Confocal (CLSM) TTTR image file(s) to analyse. Drag-drop to add.

sections.title: IRF file
sections.description: IRF TTTR measurement (the first file is used).

sections.title: Analysis region
sections.description: Restricts which of the detected regions are fitted — one cell, one illuminated patch, a field with the bright edge cropped off. Draw one, or load a saved region, a mask or a segmentation; several combine by the rule below. Empty = the whole frame.

sections.label: Detector channels
sections.description: Space-separated routing channels; even = parallel (∥), odd = perpendicular (⊥).

sections.label: Fit start
sections.description: Fit-window start on the binned micro-time axis.

sections.label: Fit stop
sections.description: Fit-window stop on the binned micro-time axis.

sections.label: Micro-time binning
sections.description: Integer down-binning of the micro-time axis before fitting.

sections.label: Detection
sections.description: Which detection in the measurement's container to fit, when it holds more than one. Regions are found by the Spot Finder; this tool fits the ones it is given.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: Regions with fewer photons in the fit window are not fitted; they keep a row, with NaN parameters.

sections.label: τ (ns)
sections.description: Initial fluorescence lifetime.

sections.label: fix τ
sections.description: Hold the lifetime fixed.

sections.label: γ
sections.description: Initial scatter fraction.

sections.label: fix γ
sections.description: Hold the scatter fraction fixed.

sections.label: r0
sections.description: Fundamental anisotropy.

sections.label: fix r0
sections.description: Hold the fundamental anisotropy fixed.

sections.label: ρ (ns)
sections.description: Rotational correlation time.

sections.label: fix ρ
sections.description: Hold the rotational correlation time fixed.

sections.label: l1
sections.description: Polarisation mixing correction l1.

sections.label: l2
sections.description: Polarisation mixing correction l2.

sections.label: 2I* (P+2S)
sections.description: Optimise P+2S instead of P and S separately.

sections.label: BIFL scatter
sections.description: Reduce Istar by the background contribution.

buttons.label: 👁️ Preview
buttons.description: Measure the regions about to be fitted, without fitting them — the same regions the run uses.

buttons.label: ▶ Run
buttons.description: Fit every detected region in every selected file; writes molecule_data.tsv + joint_output.tsv.

buttons.label: 💾 Export
buttons.description: Export the combined per-molecule table (all files) to a TSV/CSV.

sections.label: Open results
sections.description: Reopen a saved molecule_data.tsv (or joint_output.tsv) from a previous analysis to browse its molecules.

sections.title: Regions
sections.description: Browse the detected regions; the canvas marks the selected one and the panel shows its Fit23 result.

sections.title: Decay
sections.description: VV/VH decay of the selected region with the fitted Fit23 model, the IRF and the background overlaid, and the weighted residuals above sharing the time axis — the same panel the burst-wise MLE draws.
